title: Product noise operator
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\rho$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le\rho\le1$. For a real-valued function $f$ on $\Omega^n$, define its image under the product noise operator at $x\in\Omega^n$ to be the expectation of $f$ under the product noise distribution centered at $x$.
